title: FiabilityLab: A Jamovi Module for Reliability and Agreement Analysis

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source Jamovi module for evaluating measurement reliability and agreement: internal consistency, inter-rater agreement, confirmatory-factor-based (SEM) reliability, and measurement invariance across groups.
